codes.definition: Constituent has never made a gift
Made their first gift in the current fiscal year
Gave last year and gave again this year at the same level
Gave last year and increased their giving this year
Gave last year but decreased their giving this year
Previously gave but has not given in the last 1-2 fiscal years
Previously gave but has not given in 3+ fiscal years
Cumulative or single-gift giving at the institution's major gift threshold (typically $25K-$100K+)
Has documented a planned gift (bequest, trust, beneficiary designation)
Was lapsed but made a new gift this year
